title: 4.7 She cleaned the table yesterday
unit_title: Life at home, every day and yesterday
unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, talk about the lights and machines, ask what there is, describe someone's morning in order, say what you did yesterday and on which day, ask and tell the time, say how often you do things and give dates.
goal: Say what someone did yesterday at home with -ed (She cleaned the table yesterday. / They washed the clothes yesterday.).
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 4.7 Helping at home: A1 says what people do at home (I clean the table. / They wash their clothes.); A1+ 4.7 says what they did yesterday. The one new grammar relationship is the past with -ed (cleaned, washed, opened) and yesterday, under the user's 2026-11-13 decision to teach the past with regular -ed verbs and did only. The past has no he/she -s, so she cleaned and they cleaned are the same. A past cannot be photographed: each photo shows what its person does, and Listen sets the past against the present (She cleaned the table yesterday. / She cleans the table.). A1 4.7's photos of the schoolboy's mother and the boy are reused; the door photos are A1's two-panel changes (shut, then open), and the mother also washes in the photo of them both, so a She or He washed line never meets that photo as a wrong picture.
prerequisite: A1 4.7 open, close, clean, wash clothes; A1+ 1.2 he/she -s; A1 4.1 rooms.
speaking_outcome: End cleaned and opened with a soft d (CLEEND, OH-pund) and washed with a t (WOSHT); no extra syllable. Do not require native-like speed.
